selection_policy: Model selected by validation Average Precision; threshold maximizes validation F1. No test-set tuning.

warnings: Unknown labels are excluded from all evaluation metrics.

limitations: Anonymized dataset features; cannot score raw wallet addresses.
Published aggregate features may include neighborhood information unavailable at an online decision time; this is an offline temporal benchmark.
No claim of real-time blockchain detection or verified ownership.
label_provenance: Published Elliptic class labels; not independently re-verified
